SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE.
REPORT
（印：SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE C. & S. B. REGISTRY. 3746. Special Branch D. S. 2. Station 4 32 Date April 18, 1932）

Subject (in full) Arms smuggling.

Made by D.S. Moore. Forwarded by D.S.D. [签名]

Regarding the information contained in the attached
translation of a letter in French dated Batavia, March 10, 1932,
bearing on the shipment of arms and ammunition to the China
Seas. Information has been received that in the early part
of March 1932, a large quantity of rifles, machine guns and
ammunition were landed at Chuanchow, a small port north of
Amoy, Fukien Province, on the instructions and at the order
of General Chen K'uo-hui, Garrison Commander of Chuanchow.
Details as to the amount of munitions landed are lacking, but
it is known that they were discharged from a steamer flying
the Norwegian flag, which vessel carried the name "Bloda" or
"Bioll". Neither the "Bloda" or the "Bioll" are contained
on Lloyds Shipping Register. The discharge of this cargo from
the ship's hold took place a few miles outside Chuanchow under
a strong escort of General Chen K'uo-hui's troops. Martial
law was declared in Chuanchow during the actual time of landing
and the streets of the town were guarded by troops until the
escorted munitions had safely reached their destination at
General Chen's headquarters.

Whether this consignment of arms is identical with that
mentioned in the attached translation is difficult to say,
but there is a big possibility that they are one and the same.
Nothing is known in local maritime circles of any other big
shipment of arms having been illegally landed on the China
coast during recent months neither is anything known of the
individual quoted as "Eris" in the attached translation.

（左侧批注：Sec D.S.H.O.）

W.B. Moore
[签名]
Officer i/c Special Branch.
[签名]
19/4 32

上海公共租界工部局警务处。
报告
（印：上海公共租界工部局警务处 刑事与特别股登记处。3746。特别分部 D. S. 2。第4巡捕房 32 日期 1932年4月18日）

事由（全称）：武器走私。

由 D.S. Moore 撰写。由 D.S.D. 转呈 [签名]

关于随附的1932年3月10日于巴达维亚发出的法文信件译文中所载情报，该情报涉及向中国海域运送武器和弹药一事。据收到的情报称，1932年3月上旬，大批步枪、机枪及弹药在福建省厦门以北的小港口泉州上岸，此举系奉泉州卫戍司令陈国辉将军之指示和命令而行。关于上岸军火的具体数量缺乏细节，但已知这些军火是从一艘悬挂挪威国旗的轮船上卸下的，该船名为“Bloda”或“Bioll”。劳氏船级社航运注册记录中均无“Bloda”或“Bioll”这两艘船的记载。从船舱卸下这批货物是在泉州外数英里处进行的，当时有陈国辉将军的部队严密护卫。在实际上岸期间，泉州宣布戒严，城镇街道由军队把守，直至受护送的军火安全抵达陈将军的总部。

这批武器是否与随附译文中提到的那批相同，难以断言，但二者为同一批货物的可能性很大。当地海事界对近几个月来有其他大批武器非法在中国海岸上岸一事一无所知，对于随附译文中提及的名为“Eris”的个人也毫不知情。

（左侧批注：Sec D.S.H.O.）

W.B. Moore
[签名]
特别分部主管警官。
[签名]
1932年4月19日

SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE
C. & S. B. REGISTRY.
No. D 3526.
Date 2 / 4 / 32

Translation of an extract in French from the attached letter
dated Batavia, March 10, 1932.

" About two months ago a cargo of arms was despatched from the
the port of Hamburg in the direction of the Chinese sea, with the
destination for a port of Borneo Island.
It is a matter of 2000 Mauser rifles, 7-9-87, as well as of one
million rounds of ammunition.
It is a German ship carrying all kinds of merchandises and the
arms are contained in cases of white wood, in the shape of a cof-
fin, marked with a capital letter in black colour.
The ammunition is packed in soldered zinc boxes.
The trafficker is from Shanghai, " ERIS" by name, an individual
without nationality, whose residence is unknown."

**〔此处转录不清〕**

上海公共租界工部局警务处
刑事与特别股登记处。
编号 D 3526。
日期 1932年4月2日

随附的1932年3月10日于巴达维亚发出的信件的法语摘录译文。

“大约两个月前，一批武器从汉堡港启运，方向为中国海域，目的地为婆罗洲岛的一个港口。
涉及2000支毛瑟步枪，型号7-9-87，以及一百万发子弹。
这是一艘装载各类商品的德国船只，武器装在形状如棺材的白木箱中，箱上标有黑色的大写字母。
子弹装在焊接的锌盒中。
走私者来自上海，名叫‘ERIS’，是一个无国籍人士，其居住地不明。”
